messages:
ravi: FYI starting rollout for release v3.16.0 in 8m. plan: 2% -> 15% -> 60%. adding rollback quickplay + dependency checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-quickplay-1.2 :rocket:

ops-bot: [deploy] release=v3.16.0 initiated \u00b7 slice=2% \u00b7 initiator=ravi \u00b7 changelist=GH:3720


tasha: Heads-up: this touches the tokenizer cache and the streaming parser flag. rollback must include cache flush + featureflag revert. also note we have an infra migration that touches the routing table (see runbook step 5).

ravi: Quick abort commands (copy/paste):
```\n# abort and pin back to stable
./infra/deployctl abort --release v3.16.0 --reason "canary fail"
./infra/deployctl pin --service text-gen --version v3.15.3
# fallback manual route
/ops/route switch --from v3.16.0 --to v3.15.3 --immediate
# clear tokenizer cache if warm-up issues
./infra/cachectl flush --service tokenizer --scope prod
# revert parser flag
./infra/featurectl set --service text-gen --flag streaming_parser --value false
```\n
nina (sre): Monitoring checklist:
- datadog: service.text-gen.errors (1m / 5m)
- apm: service.text-gen.p95 and p99
- infra: GPU mem pressure and node restart rate
Abort criteria: errors > 0.8% sustained for 4m OR p95 > 380ms for 5m OR tokenization cache miss spike > 20% for 6m.


tasha: Who's on manual unroute if the bot cannot reach the route service?

ravi: I'm primary for automated pin. Tasha will run manual route if needed. Nina will escalate to eng-oncall and trigger the abort if thresholds hit.

ops-bot: [status] slice(2%) healthy \u00b7 errors=0.07% \u00b7 p95=205ms \u00b7 elapsed=3m

nina (sre): Set a temp alert: ping this thread at errors > 0.6% for 3m and a separate alert for token-cache-miss > 15% for 5m. Also a synthetic hitting /v1/generate for baseline correctness.

ravi: Comms rule: post a single-line starting with "ABORT:" and a short reason. deploy-bot will attempt automated abort and pin. If manual escalation needed, ping "@eng-oncall" and call the number.


deploy-bot: [progress] promoted -> 15% \u00b7 release=v3.16.0 \u00b7 start=4923456795


tasha: 15% looks okay so far but I'm watching cache warm-up. leaving this thread open for any aborts. will also update the quickplay to include the routing table note after the window. :white_check_mark:
